use_when: 如何申请运动健康服务并配置Client ID？
如何读取用户的心率、血氧、步数等日常健康采样数据？
如何读取用户的跑步、骑行、游泳等锻炼记录数据？
如何管理数据源和用户授权，确保数据获取合规？
如何获取实时三环数据（活动、锻炼、站立）？
如何读取用户的睡眠、压力、体温等健康记录数据？
如何拉起运动健康App的隐私授权页面？
如何手动触发数据同步？
各类健康数据对应的权限有哪些？如何申请正式权限？
应用开发者申请运动健康服务需要满足哪些资质要求？
当您需要开发运动健康类应用，读取用户的步数、心率、血氧、睡眠等健康数据时，可使用 Health Service Kit 的采样数据读取能力
当您需要获取用户的运动锻炼记录（如跑步、骑行、游泳等）时，可使用锻炼记录数据读取能力
当您需要开发与华为运动健康设备联动的应用，获取实时三环（活动、锻炼、站立）数据，或需要管理用户授权和数据源时，也可使用本Kit提供的相关能力
接入华为运动健康账号授权并读取用户健康数据 / Integrate Huawei Health authorization and read user health data
同步手表或手环采集的步数心率到应用 / Sync step count and heart rate collected from a watch or band into the app
显示用户当天活动圆环进度和站立达标情况 / Show the user’s daily activity rings progress and stand goals
获取最近一周的睡眠记录并做睡眠趋势展示 / Load the past week’s sleep records and display sleep trends
读取跑步骑行训练详情用于运动分析页面 / Read running and cycling workout details for an exercise analysis page
订阅健康数据更新并在数据变化后刷新界面 / Subscribe to health data updates and refresh the UI when values change
拉起系统健康授权流程让用户开启步数和心率权限 / Launch the system health consent flow so users can enable step and heart rate permissions
管理健康数据读取范围并按需申请传感器权限 / Manage health data access scopes and request sensor permissions as needed
获取血氧体温压力等指标生成每日健康概览 / Fetch SpO2, temperature, and stress metrics to build a daily health summary
手动触发运动健康数据同步后刷新本地统计 / Manually trigger Huawei Health data sync and refresh local stats
读取指定时间段的锻炼记录用于训练日历展示 / Read workouts within a time range for a training calendar view
按数据源筛选来自手机手表的健康记录 / Filter health records by data source such as phone or watch
do_not_use_when: 需求是获取GNSS/基站/WLAN/蓝牙定位结果，进行地理围栏监控，或做地理编码与逆地理编码，应改用 location-kit / The requirement is to get positioning results from GNSS, cell, WLAN, or Bluetooth, perform geofence monitoring, or do geocoding and reverse geocoding; use location-kit instead

需求是处理游戏手柄输入，监听设备上下线，查询在线手柄，或捕获A/B/X/Y、肩键、扳机、方向键和摇杆轴事件，应改用 game-controller-kit / The requirement is to handle game controller input, listen for device connect and disconnect events, query online controllers, or capture A/B/X/Y, shoulder, trigger, D-pad, and joystick axis events; use game-controller-kit instead
preconditions: 项目已开通运动健康服务并正确配置Client ID等接入信息 / The project has enabled Health Service and correctly configured access info such as Client ID
应用已集成对应SDK，并在module.json5/应用配置中声明所需权限与能力 / The app has integrated the required SDK and declared needed permissions and capabilities in module.json5/app configuration
用户已登录华为账号，并已授予目标健康数据范围的授权 / The user is signed in with a Huawei account and has granted authorization for the target health data scopes
inputs: 华为账号登录态与授权范围 / Huawei account sign-in state and authorization scopes
目标数据类型或运动类型 / Target data type or exercise type
查询时间范围或实时订阅参数 / Query time range or real-time subscription parameters
数据源信息或同步/授权操作参数 / Data source info or sync/authorization operation parameters
outputs: 用户授权状态与已授权权限范围 / User authorization status and granted permission scopes

运动健康采样数据记录（步数、热量、距离、心率、血氧、压力、体温、血压、体重、身高、睡眠分期、情绪等） / Health sampling data records (steps, calories, distance, heart rate, SpO₂, stress, body temperature, blood pressure, weight, height, sleep stage samples, mood, etc.)
锻炼记录数据（跑步、骑行、健走、跳绳、游泳、登山、滑雪等运动记录） / Workout record data (running, cycling, walking, rope skipping, swimming, hiking, skiing, etc.)
健康记录数据（睡眠等健康档案记录） / Health record data (sleep and other health record entries)
数据源对象或数据源列表（应用、设备、传感器等来源信息） / Data source object or data source list (source information for apps, devices, sensors, etc.)
实时三环数据（活动、锻炼、站立进度与状态） / Real-time three-ring data (activity, exercise, and stand progress/status)
运动健康数据写入、更新或删除结果 / Health and fitness data write, update, or delete result
手动数据同步触发结果 / Manual data synchronization trigger result

postconditions.statement: 工程中已添加运动健康服务接入配置或调用了对应初始化/授权相关代码 / The project includes Health Service integration configuration or corresponding initialization/authorization code
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add Health Service integration artifacts such as client/access configuration, SDK dependency usage, or initialization/authorization-related code?

postconditions.statement: 代码中已实现至少一种健康数据能力：采样数据、锻炼记录、健康记录、实时三环、数据源管理或手动同步 / The code implements at least one health-data capability: sample data, exercise records, health records, real-time rings, data source management, or manual sync
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there at least one concrete API flow for reading or managing Health Service data (samples, exercise records, health records, rings, data sources, or sync)?

postconditions.statement: 对用户授权与隐私合规有显式处理，例如请求授权、检查授权状态或拉起隐私授权页面 / User authorization and privacy compliance are handled explicitly, such as requesting authorization, checking authorization state, or opening the privacy authorization page
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits explicitly handle user consent/privacy for health data, for example by checking authorization, requesting scopes, or launching a privacy authorization flow?
